brief_summary: This is a multi-center, open-labeled, parallel group, randomized controlled trial to access the effect and safety of the Artificial Intelligence Assisted Insulin Titration System (iNCDSS) in patients with Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus.
brief_title: AI-Assisted Insulin Titration System on Inpatients Glucose Control
official_title: Study to Assess Artificial Intelligence-Assisted Insulin Titration System on Inpatients Glucose Control

primary_outcomes.measure: Fasting plasma glucose of T2D patients
